widget.name: Organization-Chart
widget.description: This widget is an organization chart

property.caption: Employee Data Source
property.description: Select the data source containing your employee/organization data. Must include employee ID, manager ID, and name fields at minimum.

property.caption: Employee ID
property.description: Unique identifier for each employee. Must be unique across all employees in the organization. Accepts String or AutoNumber types.

property.caption: Manager/Parent ID
property.description: Reference to the employee's direct manager using their Employee ID. Leave empty or use self-reference for the top-level employee (CEO/President). This creates the hierarchical relationship.

property.caption: Employee Name
property.description: Full name of the employee to be displayed on the organization chart node.

property.caption: Job Title
property.description: Employee's job title or position (e.g., "Software Engineer", "Senior Manager"). Displayed below the employee name.

property.caption: Profile Image
property.description: Employee's profile image. Supports: 1) String URL (e.g., "https://...image.jpg"), 2 Dynamic Image object (System.Image or custom image entity), or 3 Path to image in related entity. If not provided, initials will be shown.

property.caption: Department
property.description: Employee's department or team name (e.g., "Engineering", "Sales", "HR"). Shown as a badge on the node card.

property.caption: Email Address
property.description: Employee's email address. Currently stored but not displayed. Can be used in custom actions.

property.caption: Show Profile Images
property.description: Toggle visibility of employee profile images. When disabled, only text information is shown. Initials are displayed if no image is provided.

property.caption: Show Department
property.description: Toggle visibility of department information on employee cards. Department appears as a badge below the job title.

property.caption: On Node Click Action
property.description: Action to execute when an employee node is clicked. Use this to open detail pages, show popups, or trigger workflows. The clicked employee's context is available.

property.caption: Enable Export (PNG)
property.description: Show the "Export PNG" button in the toolbar. Allows users to download the current organization chart view as a PNG image for reports and documentation.
